# Aleph Skill v2.7.0 development notes

The v2.7.0 work shipped as part of [v2.8.0](https://github.com/d-init-d/aleph-skill/releases/tag/v2.8.0).

Aleph Skill `2.7.0` introduces Formula `2.2.0` (`deviation` / `log_ratio` edge inputs, `retention_unit: per_day|per_tick`, scale-aware divergence guard), causal adaptive point forecasting (`--model adaptive`), Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI) interval calibration (`calibrate_intervals.py`), batch offline backtesting (`run_offline_backtest.py`), turn-key numerical helpers (`quickstart_quant.py`, `repair_model_schema.py`, `--offline-provisional`), quality checks for frozen trajectories and narrative/unit mismatches, bilingual Vietnamese/English auto-causal `--into-initialized` induction, and a `validated` `packs/economics` domain pack with 31 hindcast commitments — while preserving bit-exact `2.0.0` and `2.1.0` replay and `schema_version: "2.0.0"`.

## What changed

- **Formula 2.2.0 propagation engine (`references/formula-2.2.md`)**:
  - Defaults new numerical runs to `input_mode: "deviation"` (`x_src - baseline`), eliminating baseline drift at zero intervention while supporting explicit `log_ratio` and legacy `level` modes.
  - Adds stock `retention_unit: "per_day" | "per_tick"`, scale-aware `STATE_DIVERGENCE` checks, `aleph-run-2.2`, and `aleph-trace-execution-binding-v3`.
- **Causal forecasting & conformal intervals (`references/offline-backtest.md`)**:
  - `evaluate_point_forecasts.py --model adaptive` implements causal Ridge-regularized AR(1) difference shrinkage with pre-cutoff regime screening (`damped_difference` / `trailing_mean_deviation` replay bindings).
  - `calibrate_intervals.py` and `run_offline_backtest.py` deliver finite-sample ACI conformal bounds (`p05`/`p50`/`p95`) strictly from pre-origin residuals.
- **Validation, quality, packs & DX**:
  - Added `quickstart_quant.py`, `repair_model_schema.py`, `--offline-provisional`, and `auto_causal_inducer.py apply --into-initialized`.
  - Added frozen numerical trajectory (`ENGINE_FROZEN`) and narrative/unit mismatch checks in `scripts/aleph/quality.py`.
  - Fixed `run_sensitivity.py` Formula `2.2.0` -> `aleph-engine-2.2` mapping.
  - Upgraded `packs/economics` to `validated` maturity with 31 committed hindcast cases (`packs/economics/data/us_macro_2024_2026.json`).
- **Locked bundled component**: retains D Research `3.7.0` pinned in `component-lock.json` (`aleph-component://d-research`).
